text:
dylan: Quick sync — we want to expose the 'Hidden Settings' toggle in Console behind a feature flag for beta users. Proposal: enable flag `console.ui.hidden_settings` in a canary group at 5%, validate telemetry + audit logs, then ramp to 25%. Anyone object or see missing guardrails?

sasha: sounds right. +1 on telemetry. We should make it admin-toggle only in the UI (so org admins can opt in per-org). Also make sure it's off-by-default for existing orgs.

dylan: yep — admin-only in UI is the plan. For safety: rate limit to avoid backend storms, and automatic rollback if error-rate > 1% for 5m.

rene: FYI PR landing for the front-end is #3247. It adds the hidden settings panel and the admin toggle. @matt can you peek at the accessibility bits? I left comments about focus trap.

matt: on it, will review tonight. low risk but want to check keyboard nav.

lina: comms note — need short copy for the beta invite email + a Console banner for enrolled orgs. Also add a note in Support KB about how to turn it off and audit log locations. I can draft if you want.

dylan: please do, lina. also we should include a short FAQ item: why hidden settings, data residency implications (none), and how to report regressions.

ops-bot: DeployBot: ran `flags:create` in staging for `console.ui.hidden_settings` (group: canary-beta, pct:5) — staging validation started.

dylan: here's the CLI we used for staging in case you want to mirror it locally:
```
redwoodctl flags set console.ui.hidden_settings --group=canary-beta --percent=5 --meta "source=console_beta_ui"
```
and a sample rollout config we plan to apply to prod once we verify metrics:
```json
{
  "flag": "console.ui.hidden_settings",
  "rollout": [
    {"group": "canary-beta", "pct": 5},
    {"group": "beta-orgs", "pct": 25}
  ],
  "guards": ["rate_limit:100r/m", "error_rate_rollover:1%_5m", "audit_events:true"]
}
```

sasha: let's also wire the cost/latency tracing for that panel — even small DOM changes can cause backend lookups if we introduce new setting calls. Add a per-flag latency metric.

rene: noted. I'll add a telemetry event `console.hidden_settings.toggled` with org_id, user_id, prev_state, new_state. Also log -> audit service.

lina: for comms, proposed banner copy: "New: Hidden Settings (beta) — Org admins can enable experimental Console settings for power users. Learn more -> [link]". I'll put a draft in #marketing later.

matt: reviewed PR comments, pushed fixes for focus trap and keyboard support. QA testing in staging looks clean on Chrome/Firefox.

ops-bot: MonitoringBot: canary health checks: latency p50 +2ms, error_rate 0.12% (below threshold). Continuing 2h observation.

dylan: plan of action then: 1) wait 4 hours of canary health checks, 2) merge rollout to 25% beta-orgs, 3) send beta invite comms and support KB, 4) watch metrics for 48h. Volunteers for on-call during ramp?

sasha: I can take first 24h.

rene: I can handle frontend regressions for first 12h.

lina: I'll coordinate comms and be on support standby.

dylan: awesome, thanks. I'll apply the prod rollout after 4h if health looks good. Will post an update in this thread before each step. :white_check_mark:
